name: Kyeongin Hong
about: I am a research engineer at [ENERZAi](https://enerzai.com), working on machine-learning inference optimization. I received my B.S. in [Industrial Engineering](https://ie.snu.ac.kr/en/) from [Seoul National University](https://en.snu.ac.kr/index.html).
research_interests: My interests are in combinatorial optimization, particularly the use of combinatorial structure and polyhedral methods in algorithm design.
